# ANVIL rules: react

Follow these rules for react code (**/*.tsx, **/*.jsx).

## React

# React
- Function components and hooks; follow the rules of hooks.
- Keep state minimal and colocated; derive instead of syncing.
- Accessible names for all interactive elements; semantic HTML first.
- Stable keys for lists.
